title: Observation envelope (schemaVersion 1.0.0)
description: One reported, proposed, or confirmed fact about the scene or the patient. The envelope is transport-shaped and identical in Python and TypeScript. Whether a key is allowed, which value type it carries, and the lowest confirmation level that can establish it are defined by the pinned rule package, not by this schema.

observationId.description: Stable identifier, unique within one request. Reported back in acceptedObservationIds and rejectedObservations, which are sorted by this value. The charset is restricted to ASCII so that a Python code-point sort and a JavaScript UTF-16 code-unit sort cannot disagree.

key.description: Observation key. A key outside the pinned package catalog is rejected with code unknown_observation_key and is never treated as false.

value.description: Typed value, or the literal string unknown. Booleans use true, false, or "unknown". Floats are unsupported so that both runtimes compare identical values.

source.description: How the observation was obtained. camera_proposal and model_proposal can only ever be proposed; they cannot confirm themselves.

observedAt.description: Occurrence time in strict UTC, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ. Offsets, missing milliseconds, and space separators are rejected so Python and TypeScript order observations identically.

receivedAt.description: Server or local receipt time, same strict format. Never used to order occurrences.

confirmation.description: Strength of the observation. Ranked confirmed > reported > proposed when resolving several observations of one key.
